261124 v4-audit: before / after

Before: PNGs from v4page-shots-before (git 8f10014). After: PNGs from v4page-shots-after (git e6179f1). Local Release publish, 1366x768 and 390x844, signed-in screens as the dev guest; red boxes mark changed pixels.

  • v4 audit (e6179f1): the sign-in page is the title and exactly one button (Continue as Guest gone from /login).
  • Radzen CSS loads first in <head>; app styles follow (same look).
  • /diag and /health share one health report cached for a minute; latency figures differ run to run.
  • Home/tournament boxes around model prices are data (each build seeds the model rates), not layout; the stamp box is the build date.
